rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Central Election Authority chairman's schedule, headed as approved by the Congress Working Committee on 20 November 2017, sets notification on 1 December, nominations until 4 December (3 p.m.), scrutiny and the list of valid nominations on 5 December, withdrawal until 11 December (3 p.m.), the final list of candidates on 11 December (4 p.m.), a poll if necessary on 16 December and counting and declaration of results on 19 December 2017.
